author: Mainframe Games
name: Mainframe Engine game
description: A game project for the Mainframe Engine: a class library for your nodes (MyGame), a desktop project that runs it with GameHost (MyGame.Desktop), project.mfproj and Content/.

EngineSource.description: How the game references the engine.

choices.description: The MainframeEngine NuGet package at --engine-version (no engine checkout needed).
Project references into an engine checkout (--engine-path), for working on the engine itself.

EnginePath.description: With --engine-source project: the engine checkout (the folder holding MainframeEngine.slnx); absolute, or relative to the new project folder.

EngineVersion.description: The MainframeEngine package version (a release, e.g. 1.2.0; the editor passes its own) and the engine version recorded in project.mfproj.
